clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked deep inside Stormwind Keep, the War Room serves as the strategic nerve center of the Alliance military. Ringed with armaments, historical war tomes, and tactical charts, it is where generals and strategists monitor distant fronts and coordinate the defense of the kingdom.

Branching off from the grand chambers of Stormwind Keep, the War Room is outfitted specifically for military logistics and high-level campaign planning. Its stone walls are decorated with rows of armaments, including swords, blunderbusses, and even heavy artillery cannons. Piles of military treatises and historical chronicles—such as accounts of the Second War, the Fall of Stormwind, and the Battle of Grim Batol—stand stacked on nearby tables. At the room's core lies a large tactical map table, allowing commanders and battlemasters to assess Alliance deployments across Azeroth while the royal court handles matters of state just steps away.
